title: Keycloak resolver plugin configuration
description: Config-seeds the bundled Keycloak resource-server resolver. Both `issuer` and `audience` are required to ACTIVATE the identity plane; absent either, the resolver stays inert (resolves every request to null) and the dashboard behaves exactly as before. Nothing about the provider is hardcoded. See openspec change: add-multi-user-identity-plane.

enabled.description: When false the plugin is disabled (no resolver registered) — the identity plane is inert. Default-enabled but dormant until issuer+audience are set.

issuer.description: Exact OIDC issuer URL (e.g. https://kc.example.com/realms/app). Used for discovery and exact `iss` matching. Required to activate. Pin host/scheme/port before any (iss, sub) ownership is persisted.

audience.description: Required `aud` value this resource server accepts. Required to activate.

authorizedParty.description: Optional required `azp` (the public client id). When set, tokens whose `azp` differs are rejected.

jwksUri.description: Optional explicit JWKS URL. When absent it is taken from OIDC discovery of `issuer`.

networkTimeoutMs.description: Timeout (ms) for discovery and JWKS fetches.

allowInsecureHttp.description: Permit `http:` issuer/JWKS URLs for controlled Docker development. Off in production; without it an `http:` issuer leaves the resolver inert.
